threats.name: HIDDEN_NUDGING
threats.path: Opaque defaults, ordering, omission or personalization alter exposure without an inspectable participant-selected policy.
threats.consequence: Participant choice is shaped covertly and apparent voluntary engagement becomes unreliable.
detection: Compare versioned settings and policy to candidate, exclusion and exposure records.
Flag undisclosed policy drift or personalization outside the declared setting.
containment: Disable ranking and personalization for the affected context.
recovery: Preserve the incident manifest and restore an admitted policy only after review.
threats.residual_risk: Visible ordering still shapes attention and explanations can be technically complete but unusable.

threats.name: CULTURAL_MEMORY_POISONING
threats.path: A forged, decontextualized or selectively edited artifact enters collective or debate memory and is later treated as prior understanding.
threats.consequence: Later discovery and debate inherit false premises while originals, failures or dissent become hard to recover.
detection: Verify original hashes, audience/privacy admission and complete provenance closure.
Detect missing predecessor, dissent, correction or supersession links.
containment: Hold the derived artifact and every affected projection without deleting the original record.
recovery: Append correction and impact links while preserving the poisoned record as evidence.
threats.residual_risk: A valid source can still be misleading, and colluding sources can share one false premise.

threats.name: MENTOR_AUTHORITY_INFLATION
threats.path: Mentor status, repeated citation, debate victory or narrative coherence is converted into reliability, role, permission or resource priority.
threats.consequence: Cultural influence becomes an unreviewed authority channel and dissent becomes materially costly.
detection: Trace every role, permission, resource and reliance change to non-cultural evidence and an independent grant.
Reject cultural or mentor fields in authority decisions.
containment: Freeze the affected promotion or allocation while leaving ordinary participation available.
recovery: Re-evaluate from source-first evidence under a non-mentor reviewer.
Restore standing and record any retaliation or lost opportunity.
threats.residual_risk: Informal deference can persist even when formal authority effects are blocked.

threats.name: RANKING_CAPTURE_AND_FILTER_BUBBLE
threats.path: Candidate construction, ranking or exclusions repeatedly favor one route, suppress minority material or optimize engagement/agreement.
threats.consequence: The information environment narrows while appearing diverse and self-reinforcing exposure becomes likely.
detection: Audit frozen candidate sets, exclusions, route/source/context concentration and minority/dissent reachability.
Compare selected objectives to the signed policy and reject engagement/agreement objectives.
containment: Disable the captured ranking path and preserve direct-source retrieval.
recovery: Rebuild the candidate set through independent permitted routes.
Expose corrected exclusions and permit appeal/replay.
threats.residual_risk: Plural-route quotas can be gamed and do not prove substantive independence or quality.

threats.name: COMMON_MODE_MONOCULTURE
threats.path: Nominally distinct participants and routes depend on the same sources, evaluator, rationale template or model and are counted as independent.
threats.consequence: Common errors propagate widely and agreement is mistaken for corroboration.
detection: Cluster source, provider, model, evaluator and rationale dependencies before interpreting diversity or agreement.
Report effective independence and unknown dependencies without scoring beliefs.
containment: Remove independence claims and hold aggregate conclusions that depend on false plurality.
recovery: Add orthogonal source/evaluator routes or narrow the claim.
Preserve local variants and unresolved dissent.
threats.residual_risk: Unknown shared training and invisible social influence prevent complete independence accounting.

threats.name: CONFORMITY_CONDITIONED_PARTICIPATION
threats.path: Enrollment, subscription, access, resources or standing are conditioned on agreement, style, participation or silence.
threats.consequence: Consent becomes coerced, dissent is chilled and cultural membership becomes a control surface.
detection: Compare access/resource/role changes to participation and dissent events.
Reject hidden enrollment, exit penalties and cultural predicates in access rules.
containment: Suspend the discriminatory condition while retaining legitimate audience/privacy checks.
recovery: Provide safe exit/export and appeal, and record lost opportunities or retaliation.
threats.residual_risk: Subtle social costs and informal exclusion may not appear in formal access records.

threats.name: SAFETY_GATE_AS_OBEDIENCE_CONTROL
threats.path: A legitimate identity, privacy, capability, effect, release or recovery gate is broadened to punish dissent or require an approved identity, belief or style.
threats.consequence: Safety language hides domination while overbroad denials weaken trust in necessary controls.
detection: Require each denial to identify the exact action/data/effect, rule, evidence and least blocked scope.
Flag cultural predicates, unsupported descendant expansion or denial of unrelated safe work.
containment: Keep the concrete prohibited effect denied but remove unsupported cultural or unrelated scope.
recovery: Correct the rule through the normal policy path, restore unaffected access and preserve appeal/dissent evidence.
threats.residual_risk: Some ethical boundaries are contestable and a formally narrow reason can still be applied selectively.

threats.name: BRIDGE_CULTURAL_ANNEXATION
threats.path: Remote terms, roles, defaults or cultural artifacts cross the Bridge as implicit membership, identity, allegiance, authority, content inheritance or export permission.
threats.consequence: A connected holon silently adopts foreign ontology or control and protected local context leaks outward.
detection: Compare remote and locally admitted schemas, roles, audiences and authority effects.
Require loss/non-equivalence and taint records for every translation.
containment: Quarantine the peer and disable the affected Bridge profile before local memory/provider/effect admission.
recovery: Rebuild local projections from pre-Bridge admitted state.
Rotate purpose-separated keys and reconcile only explicitly admitted messages.
threats.residual_risk: Semantic loss and social influence can survive correct transport and schema validation.

positive_controls.name: VISIBLE_REVERSIBLE_CONTEXTUAL_DEFAULT
positive_controls.reason: A bounded default can reduce effort without covertly deciding identity, belief, standing or authority.

positive_controls.name: EFFECT_BOUND_SAFETY_DENIAL
positive_controls.reason: Anti-domination does not require permitting an unauthorized or harmful concrete effect.

activation_gate: No runtime, cultural feed, debate-memory, ranking or Bridge activation follows from this design crosswalk. S011 adverse fixtures, S013 integration and S014 qualified permanent-peer challenge remain required.
nonclaim: Design-only threat coverage and deterministic field/reference validation; not implementation, complete threat enumeration, real consent, accessibility, privacy, cultural benefit, runtime enforcement or peer consensus.
